Full SetArmyMove behavior runs with only scene setup StrategyController.SetArmy stubbed, GetCityPos returning zero, and Unity Random.Range fixed at 3000. Planning, validation, city/general/army mutation, and money bytecode are unchanged.

IntoTheCity retains its complete game-state behavior; terminal Unity get_gameObject/Destroy calls are replaced by null/no-op stubs because CoreCLR rejects Unity native calls at JIT time even when unreachable.

Siege scene boundaries only: GetRoute(int,int) yields one valid waypoint; GetCityIndex returns -1 because the harness has no rendered city transforms; GetSiegeRemainingDistance reads ArmyInfo.pos instead of Unity Transform.position; Unity Object equality becomes reference equality. Group planning, reserve validation, money transfer, route length, support filtering and arrival decisions remain actual injected IL.

AttackCity decision integration: retreat route assignment and player battle dialogue are replaced by call counters; terminal Destroy/get_gameObject are no-ops. Waiting, deadline checks, support rechecks and friendly-city entry remain actual injected IL.

Skill configuration keeps the actual MagicManager.GetMagicDataInfo/LoadConfig and XML parser unchanged. Only Unity Resources.Load/TextAsset.text become a null handle plus the original extracted MagicConfig XML, avoiding CoreCLR ECall rejection. Learned-skill fixture values and combat bytecode are unchanged.
